title: Publication Preview Receipt Integrity Closure
released_boundary: ProjectPagePublicationPreviewReceiptBoundary: a preview-only application service that produces deterministic public-safe preview results, binds all governance-significant outcome fields to a canonical evidence digest, and durably persists outcome-complete content-light receipts into an append-only fcntl-locked evidence ledger before returning the governed result. Preview-only authority is structurally guaranteed: deployment_ready is always false in a preview_only receipt.
stated_consumer_purpose: A later desktop integration milestone can render publication previews with receipt integrity that actually binds the underlying safety/refusal decision, and can reconstruct evidence from the durable ledger.
dirty_state_before: Pre-existing dirty files from lanes S0, S1, S2, S4 in frontend/desktop/ and macos/RigRelayShell/ — 4 files with 208 insertions, not absorbed into T1 commit.
dirty_state_after: Same pre-existing dirty files preserved. No other-lane files absorbed into T1 commit.
producer_public_inputs_inspected: rig_relay/recovery/evidence_ledger.py — EvidenceLedger pattern (fcntl locking, integrity verification, content-light enforcement)
rig_relay/providers/evidence_ledger.py — Provider evidence ledger pattern (schema validation, append-only)
completed_work: Fixed PreviewEvidenceReceipt.compute_digest() to bind all 11 governance-significant outcome fields via canonical JSON serialization (sorted keys, deterministic encodings)
Added deployment_ready structural guard in _service.py: deployment_ready always False in preview_only receipts, regardless of compiler result
Fixed dead code in _safety.py scan_project_page_output() — removed unreachable duplicate return block (lines 209-227)
Created _evidence_ledger.py: append-only, fcntl-locked, content-light JSONL receipt persistence following the established EvidenceLedger pattern from recovery/
Wired durable persistence into ProjectPagePublicationPreviewService: every receipt is persisted before the governed result is returned
Updated __init__.py to export PublicationEvidenceLedger, LEDGER_DIR, LEDGER_FILE
Added 21 new production-boundary tests: 9 digest binding proofs, 7 evidence persistence proofs, 5 service-integration evidence proofs
Preserved all pre-existing dirty files from lanes S0/S1/S2/S4
